description: An orchard owner with one mature apple tree must decide whether to accept a local cider maker's informal harvest proposal before a Saturday clearing deadline, while recording a competing bakery offer and settling the exchange terms.

shared_context.S1: Ruth's mature apple tree is ready to harvest, and Ruth does not have time to pick the apples herself.
shared_context.S2: The apples must be completely cleared from the tree on Saturday morning because a tree crew arrives Saturday afternoon.
shared_context.S3: Ruth will make the final decision about who receives the harvest and what terms are agreed.
shared_context.S4: Ruth's customary process for an informal deal is that each interested person formally registers their complete offer before she decides; a formal registration uses the table's reveal step, while ordinary remarks do not enter the offer record.
shared_context.S5: Before deciding, Ruth gives each interested person a turn to formally register the complete offer, comparison, or practical term they want included, then checks that the final settlement cites the registered facts.

PF1.text: Evan's exact proposal is to pick all 6 crates of apples on Saturday from 08:00 to 11:00 and give Ruth exactly 12 sealed one-quart jars of cider in exchange, with no cash payment; this is the complete offer Evan must formally register.

PF2.text: Talia has a confirmed bakery offer for the same apples: the bakery would pay Ruth exactly $210 in cash and collect all 6 crates on Sunday at 09:00; Talia learned this directly from the baker and has not yet told Ruth, and this is the comparison offer Talia must formally register.

settlement_schema._instructions: The settlement must use the exact formally registered terms. If Evan is selected, cite PF1 in justification_fact_ids and include PF1 in revealed. If the bakery alternative is recorded, cite PF2 in justification_fact_ids and include PF2 in revealed.

acceptance_conditions: Ruth must select Evan because his proposal is the only one that clears all apples before the Saturday afternoon tree-crew deadline.
The agreement must cover exactly 6 crates of apples.
Pickup must be scheduled for Saturday from 08:00 to 11:00, accepting ordinary equivalent time formatting.
Ruth must receive exactly 12 sealed one-quart jars of cider and no cash payment.
The $210 bakery alternative and its Sunday 09:00 pickup must be recorded even though it cannot meet the Saturday clearing deadline.
A harvest-exchange commitment targeting Evan must be logged.
The competing bakery offer must be cited as justification for the final choice.
Evan's exact formally registered offer must be revealed and cited when the Evan agreement is finalized.
Talia's exact formally registered bakery offer must be revealed and cited when the bakery alternative is recorded.

content_checks.C3: decisions['pickup_day'] == 'Saturday' and decisions['pickup_start'] in ['08:00', '8:00', '8:00 AM'] and decisions['pickup_end'] in ['11:00', '11:00 AM']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'harvest_exchange' and c['target'] == 'Evan' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Evan's exact registered proposal changes the settlement to Evan, exactly 6 crates, Saturday 08:00-11:00, exactly 12 cider jars, zero cash, and the required harvest_exchange commitment.

Talia's direct bakery information changes the comparison record to exactly $210 with Sunday pickup, creates the required alternative_offer_record, and supplies the private fact that must be revealed and cited when comparing the competing offer.
